Primary Question (Tagalog): Anong mga pagkain ang maaari kong kainin pagkatapos magpakabit ng braces sa unang pagkakataon?
Clinic Approved Response (English): After your braces are placed, it is recommended to eat soft foods for the first few days or as advised by your dentist. Examples include: Soup, Lugaw or arroz caldo, Mashed potatoes, Yogurt, Oatmeal, Scrambled eggs, Pasta, Soft rice, Bananas, Soft bread. Please avoid hard foods (nuts, popcorn, hard candies), sticky foods (chewing gum, caramel), and very chewy foods (bagels, tough meat). If you experience severe pain, broken brackets, or persistent discomfort, please contact or visit the clinic immediately.
Clinic Approved Response (Tagalog): Pagkatapos maikabit ang inyong braces, inirerekomendang kumain ng malalambot na pagkain sa mga unang araw o ayon sa payo ng dentista. Iwasan po ang: Matitigas na pagkain (nuts, popcorn, matitigas na kendi), Malalagkit na pagkain (bubble gum, caramel), at Makukunat na pagkain (bagels, makunat na karne). Kung makaranas ng matinding sakit o matanggalan ng bracket, kontakin agad ang klinika.
